summary: Normalize invoice cents and reject negative prices across pricing and checkout modules
patch:
diff --git a/pricing.py b/pricing.py
--- a/pricing.py
+++ b/pricing.py
@@ -1,5 +1,7 @@
 def round_money(value):
     return round(value, 2)
 
 def taxable_subtotal(items):
-    return sum(items)
+    if any(price < 0 for price in items):
+        raise ValueError("Negative item price")
+    return round_money(sum(items))
diff --git a/checkout.py b/checkout.py
--- a/checkout.py
+++ b/checkout.py
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 from pricing import taxable_subtotal, round_money
 
 def invoice_total(items, rate):
     subtotal = taxable_subtotal(items)
     tax = round_money(subtotal * rate)
-    return subtotal + tax
+    return round_money(subtotal + tax)
